content.short: DEX Screener is a data platform that shows pair pricing across decentralized exchanges.
content.description: DEX Screener is a price analysis platform that delivers data streams updating at five-minute intervals across numerous decentralized exchanges and chains. The dashboard surfaces insights for arbitrage opportunities, helping users spot favorable price movements and market discrepancies. With support for over 30 chains and a thriving community of more than 30,000 active members, the platform provides broad coverage and practical market intelligence for crypto traders.
content.meta: DEX Screener is a price analysis platform with fast data streams across DEXs and chains. Discover DEX Screener and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
